scientific_scope: Prospectively preregister a new independent Lasius niger pheromone-trail Y-maze replication against the already-frozen Candidate 307 prediction before any new biological outcome exists or is accessed. This gate freezes the biological sampling structure, apparatus/stimulus mapping, wet-lab preparation, biological release distribution, endpoint translation, model prediction, analysis, quality rules, and future promotion criterion without changing or rerunning P4.

apparatus_and_stimulus.apparatus_selection_rationale: Reuse the already-frozen repository Y-maze engineering geometry and P4 dose mapping so the new biological dataset tests an existing prediction surface exactly rather than choosing a new apparatus after seeing published candidate outcomes.
apparatus_and_stimulus.marked_arm_application: Apply the frozen pheromone preparation uniformly along the full 100 mm marked-arm centerline at the frozen nominal dose.
apparatus_and_stimulus.control_arm_application: Apply the same DCM carrier volume and handling without pheromone along the full opposite-arm centerline; no negative or repulsive field is introduced.
apparatus_and_stimulus.substrate_rule: Use a fresh removable paper substrate for every trial so no prior-trial trail residue can persist.

wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.method_basis: The concentration unit is mapped directly from the already-frozen 0.0048 hindgut-equivalents/cm P4 apparatus input. The physical recipe is fixed prospectively from hindgut-equivalent arithmetic and standard DCM extraction/application technique, not from any candidate-source behavioral outcome.
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.trail_pheromone_source: dissected Lasius niger worker hindguts from exactly four donor colonies that are not among the 12 test colonies
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.stock_preparation: Dissect exactly eight worker hindguts from each of exactly four distinct non-test donor colonies, pool all 32 hindguts, rupture and macerate them in exactly 8.000 mL analytical-grade dichloromethane, and mix to a single master stock before aliquoting.
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.aliquot_rule: Split the master stock into eight 1.000 mL light-protected sealed aliquots, freeze at -20 C, thaw each aliquot once only, keep the active aliquot on ice during application, and discard remaining thawed aliquot at the end of that collection session.
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.dose_arithmetic: 4 hindgut-equivalents/mL * 0.012 mL = 0.048 hindgut-equivalents over 10 cm = 0.0048 hindgut-equivalents/cm
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.application_tool: calibrated 5 uL glass microcapillary using an exact 2 uL fill per pass
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.application_pattern: Apply six 2 uL full-length passes along the 100 mm arm centerline for 12 uL total; use the identical six-pass procedure with DCM alone on the control arm.
wet_lab_stimulus_preparation.base_cleaning_between_trials: Remove the used paper overlay, clean the reusable maze base with 70 percent ethanol, allow it to dry fully, then install a fresh paper overlay before applying the next randomized treatment.

colony_husbandry_and_test_environment.pre_deprivation_food: 0.5 M sucrose solution available ad libitum plus chopped cockroach protein three times per week

biological_sampling.sample_size_rationale: Fixed before new outcomes from precision and biological-replication considerations rather than from any contaminated published effect size. Twenty attempts per side gives a worst-case binomial-only per-side standard error of 0.1118034 at p=0.5; averaging the two balanced sides gives a binomial-only within-colony standard error of about 0.0790569, and 12 equally weighted colonies gives a binomial-only standard error of the mean of about 0.0228218, corresponding to an approximate 90 percent t half-width of 0.04099 with 11 df before additional between-colony variability. This is a planning precision benchmark, not a power guarantee; observed colony variability remains part of the preregistered interval.
biological_sampling.collection_condition: Each worker must be experimentally naive to this replication assay and used once in the preregistered outbound stem-entry condition.

randomization_and_blinding.randomization_algorithm: For each colony, create a 40-element vector containing 20 L and 20 R labels and apply Fisher-Yates shuffle using a preregistered deterministic PRNG seed; materialize and hash the complete schedule before biological collection begins.
randomization_and_blinding.collector_independence_definition: The person or team physically collecting the 480 test trials must not have participated in P4 parameter estimation, Candidate 307 selection, or this dataset's outcome analysis; identity and role are frozen at the later collection-authorization gate.
randomization_and_blinding.post_release_operator_interaction: After standardized release at the stem entry, the operator must not touch, redirect, stimulate, or otherwise interact with the ant until endpoint or timeout.

biological_release_contract.position_jitter_formula: For U1,U2 independently uniform on [0,1), angle=2*pi*U1, radius=0.4*sqrt(U2), target_x=30+radius*cos(angle), target_y=120+radius*sin(angle).
biological_release_contract.heading_jitter_formula: target_heading_rad=0+0.05*Z where Z is generated by the frozen sim-core RNG.normal Box-Muller implementation.
biological_release_contract.future_release_pose_schedule_generation_: At the collection-authorization gate, instantiate the frozen sim-core RNG with seed 93442001 and sequentially generate exactly 480 target poses in canonical colony-01 trial-01 through colony-12 trial-40 order using the frozen uniform-disk and normal formulas above. Freeze and hash the complete schedule before any collection.
biological_release_contract.physical_release_method: Use a transparent straight launch microchannel mounted on a calibrated XY-theta positioning fixture. For each trial, set the channel exit center and channel axis to that trial's frozen target x, y, and heading. Allow the ant to walk out under its own power; do not push or touch the ant after it enters the launch channel.
biological_release_contract.time_zero_definition: t=0 is the linearly interpolated time at which the tracked thorax centroid first crosses the launch-channel exit plane into the Y-maze.
biological_release_contract.release_position_measurement: At t=0, measure the thorax-centroid maze-coordinate position from the calibrated overhead video.
biological_release_contract.release_heading_measurement: At t=0, biological heading is the atan2 direction of the vector from thorax/mesosoma centroid to head centroid in maze coordinates.
biological_release_contract.release_pose_quality_rule: A trial is release-pose compliant only if measured thorax-centroid position is within 0.2 mm Euclidean distance of its scheduled target and normalized measured-heading error is at most 0.025 rad. Compliance is scored from the release frames before endpoint scoring and without access to marked-side identity or Candidate-307 prediction.

endpoint.video_geometry: overhead view with fixed maze-coordinate fiducials visible throughout each trial
endpoint.coordinate_rule: Calibrate each collection session to maze millimetres from the fixed fiducials; all release and terminal calculations use the tracked thorax/mesosoma centroid in those coordinates.
endpoint.crossing_rule: For every consecutive pair of valid centroid samples, linearly interpolate the straight segment in x,y over the actual frame timestamps. If an outside-to-inside segment intersects a 7.0 mm terminal-circle boundary, solve the segment-circle intersection and use the earliest intersection time as that circle's entry time. Boundary distance <=7.0 mm counts as inside.
endpoint.tracking_gap_rule: If a tracking gap longer than 0.05 s overlaps a period in which terminal entry cannot be ruled out from the surrounding positions, classify the trial as the preregistered tracking-failure technical exclusion rather than manually guessing an entry time.
endpoint.choice_rule: The earliest interpolated thorax-centroid entry into either terminal region at or before 90.000 s from t=0 is the irreversible binary choice.
endpoint.simultaneous_or_impossible_crossing_rule: If one interpolated segment would enter both spatially disjoint terminal regions, treat it as a tracking failure; do not choose a side manually.
endpoint.timeout_rule: If neither terminal region has a valid entry time at or before 90.000 s from t=0, record timeout; never recode a timeout as a choice and never silently drop it.

predeclared_exclusions_and_quality.timeout_fraction_scope: Only nonexcluded attempted trials enter timeout fractions. A preregistered technical exclusion is in neither the timeout numerator nor timeout denominator, but remains reported. A timeout is not an exclusion and always remains in the denominator.
predeclared_exclusions_and_quality.overall_timeout_fraction_formula: number of timeout=true trials among all nonexcluded attempts across all 12 colonies divided by total number of nonexcluded attempts across all 12 colonies
predeclared_exclusions_and_quality.per_colony_timeout_fraction_formula: number of timeout=true trials among a colony's nonexcluded attempts divided by that colony's total number of nonexcluded attempts

primary_estimand.name: equal_colony_weighted_side_balanced_marked_arm_choice_probability
primary_estimand.per_colony_left_marked_fraction: marked-arm choices divided by eligible completed choices among the 20 planned left-marked attempts after only preregistered technical exclusions
primary_estimand.per_colony_right_marked_fraction: marked-arm choices divided by eligible completed choices among the 20 planned right-marked attempts after only preregistered technical exclusions
primary_estimand.per_colony_side_balanced_fraction: mean of the colony left-marked and right-marked eligible completed-choice fractions
primary_estimand.overall_estimate: arithmetic mean of the 12 colony side-balanced fractions; each colony receives equal weight

statistical_comparison.equivalence_margin_rationale: A priori model-level predictive tolerance chosen before new biological outcomes and without reference to contaminated published candidate rates; it requires substantially more than direction-only agreement while allowing ordinary biological and colony variation.
statistical_comparison.equivalence_interval: Two-sided 90% Student-t confidence interval for the mean of the 12 colony-level primary discrepancies.
statistical_comparison.direction_interval: Two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval for the mean of the 12 colony-level side-balanced marked-arm choice fractions.
statistical_comparison.interval_formula: mean plus-or-minus t_critical times sample_standard_deviation_of_the_12_colony_values divided by sqrt(12), using Bessel-corrected sample standard deviation (denominator n-1).
statistical_comparison.reason_no_multiple_comparison_correction: There is one preregistered primary predictive comparison and one conjunctive directional requirement; side-specific and timeout summaries are diagnostics, not additional promotion claims.

next_gate.purpose: After this preregistration is reviewed, merged, and qualified on permanent main, freeze the deterministic marked-side randomization schedule, deterministic release-pose schedule, physical collector identity/independence record, chemical-batch preparation record template, video/coordinate-calibration record template, and trial-data schema; verify that no new biological outcomes exist or have been accessed; and only then authorize independent biological collection under this exact protocol.
